newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia shares close at new highs as banks surge.
newsitem.headline: Estonia shares close at new highs as banks surge.

text.p: A rise in all banking shares on the Tallinn bourse on Monday helped the market to end at a new record with Forekspank and Hansapank leading the way.
The two were boosted by the release of half-year consolidated results while Foreks also made a new, higher estimate for its annual 1997 profits.
Total turnover was 99.7 million kroons and the market index rose 3.58 percent to a new record of 346.14.
Dealers were optimistic the upward trend would continue, with maybe some pauses for breath.
"A price correction may consist of prices remaining stable for a while (rather than falling)," a dealer said.
Forekspank gained eight kroons to 217 kroons on 14.3 million kroons of turnover.
One trader said that Forekspank had more potential to rise as it was cheaper than other key banking stocks.
Hansapank rose seven kroons to 198 kroons while Hoiupank's closing price was 200.20 kroons, 5.90 kroons higher.
Uhispank gained 4.90 kroons to 61.90 kroons, supported by active trade on the Helsinki bourse, where it is also quoted.
Dealers said that investors were keeping up the buying pressure, encouraged by financial results as well as optimism over the macro-economic background.
